name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
description: National database and registration of unorganised sector workers to extend social security benefits.
eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59, not members of EPFO/ESIC, with Aadhaar.
benefits: e-Shram card; eligibility for future social security/welfare schemes; portability.
application_steps: Visit eshram.gov.in; self-register with Aadhaar OTP.
Fill personal, occupation, and bank details.
processing_time: Instant card generation after Aadhaar OTP verification.
validity: Card valid; update on change of details.

faq.a: Unorganised workers not covered by EPFO/ESIC, such as gig, migrant, and informal workers.

ai_summary: e-Shram registers unorganised workers (16-59, not EPFO/ESIC) for social security; free Aadhaar-based.
ai_explanation: e-Shram builds a national registry of informal workers using Aadhaar and bank details. Registered workers get a UAN-based e-Shram card and become eligible for various welfare schemes. It is free and complements EPFO/ESIC coverage.
